findings.location: Paragraph beginning “Akiwa na umri wa miaka kumi na moja”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “mlegevu” with “asiyejua kujimudu vizuri” or another phrase conveying awkwardness rather than sluggishness.
findings.translation_quote: “mvulana mkubwa, mlegevu na aliyekua kupita kiasi”

findings.location: Paragraph beginning “‘The Light of the World is Jesus’ uliandikwa”
findings.source_quote: “Mr. Bliss was likely relying on a lamp or a candle.”
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the unsupported specification “ya mafuta”; for example, say “alikuwa akitegemea taa au mshumaa.”
findings.translation_quote: “inaelekea Bw. Bliss alitegemea taa ya mafuta au mshumaa”
